name: Audio Player
description: Keep a shared library of audio tracks by link and play them in a browser player
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may list tracks, play them and count plays; require auth for adding tracks, and only the user who added a track may delete it (403 otherwise); admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account
Tracks are stored as links: the app keeps each track's audio url and metadata and does not store or fetch audio files itself

Track validation: title is a required non-empty string of at most 200 characters, artist an optional string of at most 200 characters, url a required valid URL of at most 500 characters, duration an optional whole number of seconds from 0 to 86400

GET /api/tracks lists active tracks, newest first; ?query= matches title or artist case-insensitively, ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 20, at most 100), and total counts every matching track
POST /api/tracks/:id/plays adds one to the track's play_count; the player calls it when a track starts playing
Deactivated tracks (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/tracks and answer 404 on the public track endpoints; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for another user's track or a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids
frontend_requirements: Everyone can browse and play tracks; signed-in users also get the add-track form and a delete control on their own tracks, and visitors see a 'Sign in to add tracks' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Track list: title, artist, duration (m:ss) and play count with a play button per track, a search box over title and artist, and previous/next paging

A player bar that stays visible while browsing: current title and artist, play/pause, previous/next through the listed tracks, and a seekable progress bar with elapsed and total time; it shows a clear message when a track's audio cannot be loaded
An add-track form (title, artist, url, duration) that shows the API's validation messages next to the form; delete asks for confirmation first
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every track, active or not, with total, active and inactive counts and the total number of plays
Toggle a track's active status from the overview

api_endpoints.description: List active tracks, newest first, filtered and paged
